notes: One pick, uses the steady viewership and the 40% drop.

responses.value: I'd split profit into ad prices, ad slots sold, fees from cable and streaming carriers, and programming costs. I'd start with average price per ad by daypart for three years, since viewers held steady, so advertisers paying less is the likeliest cause.
Programming costs: viewers held steady and so did ad prices, so the 40% profit drop has to be costs, and programming is the biggest one.
